{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Correct assay_batch B values: they are in µg/L, so divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
# We will compute the conversion factor and apply it
conversion_factor = 10.0  # As per data dictionary: 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL

# Apply correction: batch B values are in µg/L, so divide by 10 to get ng/mL
data_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'] = data_dedup['biomarker_final']
data_dedup.loc[data_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_corrected'] /= conversion_factor

# Step 3: Compute the mean of the corrected biomarker_final
mean_biomarker_final = data_dedup['biomarker_final_corrected'].mean()

# Compute the number of unique patients
n_patients = data_dedup.shape[0]

# Print all required values: number of patients, conversion factor, mean
print(f"Number of unique patients: {n_patients}")
print(f"Conversion factor (µg/L to ng/mL): {conversion_factor}")
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final}")"}
